counting_basis: The covered counts use the CWE-012 validator gate definition (Section 8.2): concepts and cases traceable to primary_substantive source records. Both records in this pack are quality unverified and rights reference_only, so the gate count is honestly 0 and 0, the gate is not met for either work, and the pack qualification is bibliographic_only. The descriptive counts below report what the CWE-011 export actually contains; they are not gate counts and must not be read as substantive coverage.

export_basis.concept_units_excluded: The two concept units titled Direct Quotes (one per book) are excluded from pack evidence because their content is unverified quote candidates.
export_basis.quote_candidate_status: All 211 candidates carry verification_status candidate with original_speaker assigned by credited-author default. The CWE-012 integration run verified 0 of them (QUOTE_TEXT_NOT_IN_SOURCE; the export retains no source text). Candidates are never presented as verified quotations anywhere in this pack.

note: Both required anchors are present in the CWE-011 export as concept-level derivative notes. Nothing is fabricated to fill the substantive gate: the honest state is bibliographic_only until provenance-verified substantive material (a v2 export with retained text and page-level locators) exists.
required_minimum: For each book anchor: at least three independently traceable concepts plus one application case, each linked to a verified source record. Seats grounded in interviews or documented teaching meet the equivalent bar per anchor named in sources.json.
